blurb: Synergy Dance Academy provides dance training focused on strong foundations, technical excellence, and long-term growth. They offer a variety of dance classes including ballet, jazz, modern, hip hop, tap, tumbling, and pointe, with placement based on skill level rather than age alone. The academy hosts an annual recital and performance opportunities such as The Nutcracker and competitive dance teams.
extraNote: Registration fee $40 includes link to recital video · Only students registered before January 15 are eligible to participate in the June recital · Recital tickets typically $22; flowers/gifts and recital t-shirt optional expenses · August 17, 2026 through May 29, 2027
